restrictions.justification: Doomsayer is a development successor class. It preserves legacy Harbinger records and grants no native heritage edge.

overview.title: The Doomsayer
overview.subtitle: The end is not predicted. It is scheduled.
overview.description: A Doomsayer declares a finite public calamity, sets its trigger and clock, and lets the table watch it arrive. Two slots, one resolution and a Havoc ledger keep the doom exact.

quickOverview.title: Class Overview
quickOverview.content: Two public calamities, one resolution each, Havoc 0-15. Plant the Calamity and Dismantle the Sign are core. Four optional records at every level and one bounded signature and capstone per tree. Manual tabletop only.

overview.combatRole: Delayed single-target and area control through public clocks, with bounded finishers and ally forewarning.

playstyle.title: Turn 1
playstyle.content: Declare the exact subject, trigger, clock, effect and disruption. Do not hide the terms. Resolve once when the trigger or expiry occurs, then close the record and record the correct Havoc gain.

roleplayIdentity.title: A public ending, not a secret debt
roleplayIdentity.content: Doomsayer is the approved successor name for Harbinger. It does not inherit Fate Weaver links, Augur omens or Oracle forecasts. Legacy Harbinger characters keep their exact Mayhem and known IDs.

overview.currentCrisis: Development class; no native heritage access is registered. The Frozen Archive, Anhur vent-readings and Tessic rehearsal traditions are recommendations pending approval.

specializations.title: Three Doom Disciplines
specializations.description: First investment chooses a primary tree. Five talent points per level, global cap fifty. Signatures require ten same-tree points at level three; capstones forty-five at level ten.

resourceSystem.name: Calamities & Havoc
resourceSystem.title: Calamities & Havoc
resourceSystem.subtitle: Two declared endings and the wreckage they leave.
resourceSystem.description: Record at most two public calamities, each with an exact subject, trigger, one-to-three own-turn clock, published effect and public disruption method. Resolve each once. Trigger resolution grants 3 Havoc, expiry grants 1 and dismantle grants 0; Havoc runs 0-15 and resets only on a completed long rest.

cards.title: Calamities (0-2)
cards.details: Each active calamity records its subject, trigger, clock, effect and disruption. A declaration never creates a hidden clock or an automatic timer.

cards.title: Havoc (0-15)
cards.details: Trigger resolution grants 3 Havoc; expiry grants 1; dismantle grants 0. Excess above 15 is lost. Havoc never refreshes on reconnect or initiative.

cards.title: Resolution Once
cards.details: A calamity resolves exactly once, then its record closes. No record is reopened or silently duplicated.

rows: Close the record and free its slot after resolution
Close the record and free its slot

usage.momentum: Plant a clear public calamity early, let the table see the clock, and collect Havoc only when the declared ending actually arrives.
usage.flourish: Spend Havoc on authored finishers and warnings, but keep at most two active records and never assume a clock advanced without a recorded paid action.

mechanics.title: Manual Calamity Ledger
mechanics.content: At most two active calamities. Each has an exact subject or visible area, a declared trigger, a one-to-three own-turn clock, one published effect and one public disruption method. Resolution is a table event, not a background timer.

mechanics.text: Advance only through an authored paid action or an explicitly recorded table event.
No initiative, reconnect, rest or scene change advances a clock.
Resets to 0 only on a completed long rest; overflow is lost.

overheatRules.title: Doom Overflow
overheatRules.content: A third active declaration is rejected without changing the existing two records. Havoc above 15 is lost rather than converted into damage, healing or another resource. A dismantled calamity frees its slot but grants no Havoc and reverses no accepted consequence.

playingInPerson.title: The Doom Ledger
playingInPerson.subtitle: Two visible clocks and a Havoc bowl
playingInPerson.content: Use two calamity cards and a Havoc bowl of fifteen tokens. Write the subject, trigger, clock, effect and disruption method on each card. Turn the card face down only when it closes, never to hide its terms. Move one Havoc token only when the table confirms a resolution; reset the bowl only after a completed long rest.

resourceSystem.nativeNote: No native heritage edge is registered. Skald, Anhur and Tessic are recommendations only.

restrictions.justification: Oracle is an independent development class. It does not inherit Augur Benediction, Malediction or Omen Debt and grants no native heritage edge.

overview.title: The Oracle
overview.subtitle: Two possible futures, carefully prepared.
overview.description: An Oracle commits one or two exact forecasts, names the event that would fulfill each and prepares a bounded benefit. No debt, no dice replacement and no hidden omniscience.

quickOverview.title: Class Overview
quickOverview.content: Two forecast slots, each with an exact subject, category, benefit and one-or-two own-turn expiry. Commit a Forecast and Release the Forecast are core. Four optional records at every level and one bounded signature and capstone per tree. Manual tabletop only.

overview.combatRole: Prepared support and insight: personal preparation, named ally protection and declared route benefits.

playstyle.title: Turn 1
playstyle.content: Choose a subject and a category before the event. Publish the benefit and expiry. When the event occurs, apply the benefit once and close the slot; if it fails or expires, record that and grant nothing.

roleplayIdentity.title: A prepared reading, not a debt or a die swap
roleplayIdentity.content: Oracle is independent of Augur and Fate Weaver. It does not restore Omen Debt, Benediction, Malediction or consequence threads. It reads observable evidence and prepares a limited response.

overview.currentCrisis: Development class; no native heritage access is registered. Lumian star-watching and Ordu route-reading are recommendations pending approval.

resourceSystem.name: Forecasts
resourceSystem.title: Forecast Slots
resourceSystem.subtitle: Two prepared possibilities, no debt and no dice.
resourceSystem.description: Record at most two prepared forecasts. Each names one exact subject, one event category, one published benefit and a one-or-two own-turn expiry. Fulfillment grants the benefit once; failure or expiry grants nothing. There is no Omen Debt and no die replacement.

cards.title: Forecast Slots (0-2)
cards.details: A forecast occupies one slot until it fulfills, fails, expires or is released. No third slot exists.

cards.title: Exact Terms
cards.details: Each forecast is published before the event. The table records fulfillment once; a failed or expired forecast awards nothing.

cards.title: No Debt, No Dice
cards.details: Oracle does not accumulate debt and never replaces, banks or rerolls a die result. Reading uses observable evidence or bounded GM vision.

usage.momentum: Prepare a forecast before the event, keep its terms public and spend the benefit only when the named category actually occurs.
usage.flourish: Use two slots for one personal preparation and one ally protection, or commit to a route; never assume an event happened without the table confirming it.

mechanics.title: Manual Forecast Ledger
mechanics.content: At most two prepared forecasts. Each has an exact subject, one event category from the closed list, one published benefit and a one-or-two own-turn expiry. Fulfillment, failure and expiry are table events, never hidden timers.

mechanics.text: Exactly two. A third prepared forecast is rejected unchanged.

No die is replaced, rerolled or banked.

overheatRules.title: Failed Prophecy
overheatRules.content: A forecast that fails or expires grants nothing. It is not converted into debt, damage or a replacement slot. A duplicate or invalid declaration is rejected without changing the two existing slots.

playingInPerson.title: The Two-Slot Table
playingInPerson.subtitle: Two forecast cards and a visible expiry marker
playingInPerson.content: Use two forecast cards. Write the exact subject, category, benefit and own-turn expiry on each. Turn the card over only when the event is confirmed. On failure or expiry, write the outcome and clear the card. Never add a third card or a debt track.

resourceSystem.nativeNote: No native heritage edge is registered. Lumian and Ordu are recommendations only.
